cases.sentence: Рот ее сжался, ___ щеки затрясся на правой стороне бледного нервного лица.
cases.translation: Her mouth tightened, a muscle in her cheek twitched on the right side of her pale, nervous face.
cases.explain: Мускул is the grammatical subject of затрясся (twitched), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Она чувствовала, что боится его и боится предстоящего ___.
cases.translation: She felt that she was afraid of him and afraid of the coming meeting.
cases.explain: The verb бояться (to fear) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Она не велела учиться, а велела идти гулять с мизгуль к ___.
cases.translation: She did not tell them to study, but told them to go for a walk with the governess to grandmother's.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Она хотела уйти, но пошатнулась и взялась за ___ стула, чтобы опереться.
cases.translation: She wanted to leave, but staggered and grasped the back of the chair to steady herself.
cases.explain: The verb phrase взяться за (to grab onto) governs the accusative case.

cases.translation: "Dolly!" he repeated with a tremor in his voice.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Она чувствовала, что если здесь, в своем ___, она едва успевала ухаживать за своими пятью детьми, то им будет еще хуже там, куда она поедет.
cases.translation: She felt that if here, in her own house, she could hardly manage to look after her five children, it would be still worse for them there, wherever she went.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Услыхав шаги ___, она остановилась, глядя на дверь и тщетно пытаясь придать своему лицу строгое и презрительное выражение.
cases.translation: Hearing her husband's footsteps, she stopped, looking at the door and vainly trying to give her face a stern, contemptuous expression.
cases.explain: Мужа depends on шаги (the footsteps of), a noun-of-noun relationship that takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Она быстрым взглядом оглядела с головы до ног его сияющую свежестью и ___ фигуру.
cases.translation: With a quick glance she looked him up and down, his figure glowing with freshness and health.
cases.explain: The participle сияющую (glowing with) governs the instrumental case for what one glows with.

reading.ru: Дарья Александровна в кофточке с пришпиленными на затылке косами уже редких, когда-то густых и прекрасных волос, сосунувшимся худым лицом и большими выдававшимися от худобы лица испуганными глазами, стояла среди разбросанных по комнате вещей предоткрытую шифоньеркой, из которой она выбирала что-то.
reading.question: What was Darya Alexandrovna doing when Stepan Arkadyich entered?
options: Standing among scattered things, choosing something from an open wardrobe
reading.correct: Standing among scattered things, choosing something from an open wardrobe
reading.explain: She stood amid things scattered about the room in front of the open wardrobe, from which she was picking something out.

reading.ru: Она чувствовала, что боится его и боится предстоящего свидания.
reading.question: What did Dolly feel as her husband approached?
options: Fear of him and of the coming meeting
reading.correct: Fear of him and of the coming meeting
reading.explain: She felt that she was afraid of him and afraid of the meeting to come.

reading.ru: Она только что пыталась сделать то, что пыталась сделать уже десятый раз в эти три дня — отобрать детские и свои вещи, которые она увезет к матери, и опять не могла на это решиться.
reading.question: What had Dolly tried to do for the tenth time in three days?
options: Pack her and the children's things to take to her mother's
Write a letter to her husband
Call a doctor for the children
reading.correct: Pack her and the children's things to take to her mother's
reading.explain: She had again tried, for the tenth time in three days, to gather the children's and her own things to take to her mother's, and again could not bring herself to it.

reading.ru: Это было невозможно, потому что она не могла отвыкнуть считать его своим мужем и любить его».
reading.question: Why couldn't Dolly bring herself to leave?
options: She could not stop thinking of him as her husband and loving him
Her mother refused to take her in
She had no money of her own
reading.correct: She could not stop thinking of him as her husband and loving him
reading.explain: It was impossible because she could not unlearn considering him her husband and loving him.

reading.ru: И то в эти три дня Меньшой заболел от того, что его накормили дурным бульоном, а остальные были вчера почти без обеда.
reading.question: What happened to the youngest child during these three days?
options: He fell ill from being fed bad broth
reading.correct: He fell ill from being fed bad broth
reading.explain: The youngest child fell ill from being fed bad broth, and the rest went almost without dinner the day before.

reading.ru: «Долли», — сказал он тихим, робким голосом.
reading.question: In what tone did Stepan Arkadyich first address his wife?
reading.correct: A quiet, timid voice
reading.explain: He said "Dolly" in a quiet, timid voice.

reading.ru: «Это доброта противная, за которую все так любят его и хвалят. Я ненавижу эту его доброту», — думала она.
reading.question: What did Dolly think about his good nature?
options: She hated the likeable kindness everyone praised him for
reading.correct: She hated the likeable kindness everyone praised him for
reading.explain: She thought his was a repulsive kindness that everyone loved and praised him for, and that she hated it.

reading.ru: «Уйдите! Уйдите! Уйдите!» не глядя на него, вскрикнула она, как будто крик этот был вызван физическую болью.
reading.question: How did Dolly cry out at him?
options: "Go away! Go away! Go away!" as if in physical pain
reading.correct: "Go away! Go away! Go away!" as if in physical pain
reading.explain: She screamed "Go away! Go away! Go away!" without looking at him, as if the cry were caused by physical pain.

reading.ru: Что-то подступило к горлу, и глаза его заблестели слезами.
reading.question: What physical reaction did Stepan Arkadyich have on seeing her suffering?
options: A lump rose in his throat and his eyes filled with tears
reading.correct: A lump rose in his throat and his eyes filled with tears
reading.explain: Something rose in his throat, and his eyes glistened with tears.

reading.ru: «Долли, что я могу сказать? Одно — прости, прости. Вспомни, разве девять лет жизни не могут искупить минуты? Минуты!»
reading.question: What did he ask her to weigh against his moment of weakness?
reading.correct: Nine years of married life
reading.explain: He asks whether nine years of life together cannot atone for a moment's lapse.

reading.ru: «Уйдите! Уйдите отсюда!» — закричала она еще пронзительнее. «И не говорите мне про ваше увлечение, про ваши мерзости!»
reading.question: What did Dolly refuse to hear about?
reading.correct: His infatuation and vile behavior
reading.explain: She screamed even more piercingly, telling him not to speak to her of his infatuation and his vile deeds.

reading.ru: «Долли», — проговорил он, уже всхлипывая, — «ради Бога, подумай о детях. Они не виноваты. Я виноват.
reading.question: Whom did he say was blameless in all this?
reading.correct: The children
reading.explain: He begs her, for God's sake, to think of the children, saying they are not to blame, that he is to blame.

reading.ru: «Ты помнишь детей, чтоб играть с ними, а я помню и знаю, что они погибли теперь», сказала она, видимо, одну из фраз, которые она за эти три дня не раз говорила себе.
reading.question: What did Dolly accuse him of regarding the children?
options: That he only remembered them to play with, while she knew they were ruined now
That he never thought of them at all
That he loved them too much
That he wanted to send them away
reading.correct: That he only remembered them to play with, while she knew they were ruined now
reading.explain: She says he remembers the children only to play with them, while she knows they are now ruined.

reading.ru: После того, как мой муж, отец моих детей, входит в любовную связь с гувернанткой своих детей...
reading.question: What relationship did Dolly describe her husband as having entered into?
options: A love affair with his children's governess
reading.correct: A love affair with his children's governess
reading.explain: She describes her husband, the father of her children, entering a love affair with his children's governess.

reading.ru: «Вы мне гадки! Отвратительно!» — закричала она, горяча все более и более.
reading.question: How did Dolly's anger escalate?
options: She grew hotter, calling him vile and disgusting
reading.correct: She grew hotter, calling him vile and disgusting
reading.explain: She cried out that he was vile and disgusting to her, growing more and more heated.

reading.ru: В это время в другой комнате, вероятно, упавши, закричал ребенок.
reading.question: What interrupted the confrontation between Stepan Arkadyich and Dolly?
options: A child crying out in another room, apparently having fallen
reading.correct: A child crying out in another room, apparently having fallen
reading.explain: At that moment a child cried out in another room, apparently having fallen.

reading.ru: Если вы пойдете за мной, я позову людей, детей. Пускай все знают, что вы подлец.
reading.question: What did Dolly threaten to do if he followed her?
options: Call the servants and children so everyone would know he was a scoundrel
reading.correct: Call the servants and children so everyone would know he was a scoundrel
reading.explain: She threatens that if he follows her, she will call the servants and children so that everyone will know he is a scoundrel.

reading.ru: Была пятница, и в столовой часовщик немец заводил часы.
reading.question: What was happening in the dining room that day?
options: A German clockmaker was winding the clocks
reading.correct: A German clockmaker was winding the clocks
reading.explain: It was Friday, and in the dining room the German clockmaker was winding the clocks.

reading.ru: «Так устрой же все там с Марьей в диванной для Анны Аркадьевны!» — сказал он явившемуся Матвею.
reading.question: What did Stepan Arkadyich instruct Matvei to arrange?
options: A room in the sitting-room for Anna Arkadyevna
reading.correct: A room in the sitting-room for Anna Arkadyevna
reading.explain: He tells Matvei to arrange everything with Marya in the sitting-room for Anna Arkadyevna.

reading.ru: Дарья Александровна, между тем успокоив ребенка и по звуку кареты, поняв, что он уехал, вернулась опять в спальню.
reading.question: How did Dolly know her husband had left?
options: By the sound of the carriage
She saw him from the window
reading.correct: By the sound of the carriage
reading.explain: Having calmed the child, she understood from the sound of the carriage that he had left, and returned to her bedroom.
